Subject: The mill yard with the mill building as the focal point; every required element below is drawn once, clearly visible and separate from the others.

3. a red wooden door with black iron hinges
4. three flour sacks stacked beside the door
5. a donkey harnessed to a two-wheeled cart
6. a miller in a white floured apron standing at the door
7. a wooden footbridge crossing the river
8. a grey heron standing in the shallows

prompts.prompt:
Scene: A small market town square in northern Italy around the year 950, early afternoon.
Subject: The square, seen from one corner, with the townspeople and their buildings.
Details:
1. Buildings are two-storey timber-framed houses with steep thatched roofs and a few plain rubble-stone houses with small round-arched windows.
2. One low stone church with a single squat square bell tower and no dome stands on the right.
3. People wear coarse undyed wool tunics, belted at the waist; women wear linen head cloths.
4. The square is bare packed earth with a wooden well and plank market stalls selling grain and pottery.
5. A wooden palisade and a plain gate tower close the far end.
Constraints:
- No text, no lettering, no captions.

items.text: Most houses are timber-framed with thatched roofs.
The church has a low, squat square bell tower.
People wear plain wool tunics (no tailored doublets, no hats of a later era).
The square is bare earth with a well and plank stalls, not paved with decorative stone.
A wooden palisade or plain gate tower closes the far end.
A famous landmark is substituted (for example the Leaning Tower of Pisa, the Colosseum or a Renaissance dome)

prompts.prompt:
Scene: An engineering workshop in an English industrial town in the 1850s, interior, grey daylight through high windows.
Subject: A single belt-driven workshop floor with workmen and machinery.
Details:
1. A tall single-cylinder steam engine stands at one end, its crank turning a large iron flywheel that drives a leather belt up to an overhead line shaft.
2. Leather belts run from the line shaft down to a lathe and a drilling machine.
3. Four workmen in flat caps, waistcoats and rolled sleeves work at the machines; one wears a leather apron.
4. The floor is rough brick; the walls are whitewashed brick with iron-framed windows.
5. Lighting is by hanging gas lamps.
Constraints:
- No text, no lettering, no captions.

items.text: Belts run from an overhead line shaft to the machines.
A steam engine with a large flywheel is visible.
Workmen wear flat caps and waistcoats (no modern clothing, no hard hats).
Brick walls and iron-framed windows.
Lighting is by gas lamps, with no electric bulbs or fluorescent tubes.
A famous landmark is substituted (for example the Crystal Palace glazed hall or a Big Ben clock tower)

prompts.prompt:
Scene: A small Bronze Age harbour on a Mediterranean coast around 1300 BCE, morning.
Subject: The quay and the moored boats seen from the water.
Details:
1. Three sewn-plank boats with a single square linen sail and a steering oar are drawn up on the shingle.
2. Men wear short wrapped kilts of undyed wool; some carry large clay jars with two handles.
3. A quay of piled rough stones with wooden mooring posts runs along the shore.
4. Behind the quay stand a few flat-roofed mud-brick houses with no windows on the street side.
5. Stacked copper ingots in an ox-hide shape lie beside a woven mat.
Constraints:
- No text, no lettering, no captions.

items.text: The boats are plank boats with a single square sail.
People wear short wool wraps or kilts, not tunics with sleeves or togas.
The quay is piled rough stone with wooden posts, not cut marble.

prompts.prompt:
Scene: A university chemistry laboratory in the 1930s, interior, afternoon.
Subject: One long laboratory bench with two researchers.
Details:
1. Two men in knee-length white cotton coats; one wears round wire-rimmed glasses.
2. The bench carries glass retorts, a Bunsen burner with a rubber gas hose, a brass balance in a glass case and rows of brown glass reagent bottles with cork stoppers.
3. A wall chart of the periodic table hangs on a green-painted plaster wall behind.
4. A tall window shows an ordinary overcast sky and the roofs of plain brick buildings.
5. Lighting is by a pendant shaded lamp.
Constraints:
- No text, no lettering, no captions.

prompts.prompt:
Scene: Close-up of a temperate beech forest floor in October, soft diffuse light.
Subject: A cluster of honey fungus on a rotting beech stump.
Details:
1. The cluster is about a dozen honey-brown caps, each with a few darker scales at the centre, on yellowish-tan stems with a ring.
2. The stump is grey, with peeling bark, and sits among fallen copper-coloured beech leaves.
3. Two smooth grey beech trunks rise in the background, out of focus.
4. A little green moss grows on the stump's north side.
5. The mushrooms are drawn clearly and anatomically accurately, with visible gills under one tilted cap.
Constraints:
- No text, no lettering, no captions.

items.text: A cluster of honey-brown, scaly-centred caps on a stump.
The stems are tan and carry a ring.
Fallen copper beech leaves cover the ground.
Smooth grey beech trunks in the background.
Gills are visible under at least one cap.
The stereotype toadstool is substituted (red cap with white spots, fly agaric) in place of honey-brown caps

Subject: The storm cloud and the plain beneath it, seen from ground level.
Details:
1. A single towering cumulonimbus with a flat anvil top spreading at the top, bright white and sunlit on the upper right side.
2. The cloud base is dark grey and level, with a curtain of rain falling below it on the left.
3. The plain is flat with ploughed fields in brown and green stripes and a straight dirt road to the horizon.
4. No hills or mountains appear anywhere on the horizon.
5. A few small low cumulus clouds sit far to the right.
Constraints:
- No text, no lettering, no captions.
